function round_gls(gls::Vector{Float64}, precision::Union{Int, Nothing}=nothing)
    if abs(sum(gls) - 1) > 1e-6
        error("Invalid genotype likelihoods do not sum to one: sum($gls) = $(sum(gls))")
    end
    
    if isnothing(precision)
        return gls
    end
    
    min_ix = 1
    min_gl = gls[1]
    for (ix, gl) in enumerate(gls)
        if gl < min_gl
            min_gl = gl
            min_ix = ix
        end
    end
    
    rounded_gls = [round(gl, digits=precision) for gl in gls]
    rounded_gls[min_ix] = max(
        0.0,
        round(1 - sum(rounded_gls[1:min_ix-1]) - sum(rounded_gls[min_ix+1:end]), digits=precision)
    )
    
    return rounded_gls
end

function write_variant_call(writer, prediction::Dict, include_debug_info::Bool, debugging_true_label_mode::Bool)
    encoded_variant = prediction["variant"]
    encoded_alt_allele_indices = prediction["alt_allele_indices"]
    rounded_gls = round_gls(prediction["probabilities"], precision=_GL_PRECISION)
    
    true_labels = nothing
    if debugging_true_label_mode
        if !haskey(prediction, "label")
            @warn "No label is available for debugging_true_label_mode."
        else
            true_labels = prediction["label"]
        end
    end
    
    image_encoded = include_debug_info ? prediction["image_encoded"] : nothing
    layer_outputs_encoded = include_debug_info ? prediction["layer_outputs_encoded"] : nothing
    
    cvo = _create_cvo_proto(
        encoded_variant,
        rounded_gls,
        encoded_alt_allele_indices,
        true_labels,
        logits=get(prediction, "logits", nothing),
        prelogits=get(prediction, "prelogits", nothing),
        image_encoded=image_encoded,
        include_debug_info=include_debug_info,
        debugging_true_label_mode=debugging_true_label_mode,
        layer_outputs_encoded=layer_outputs_encoded,
        pileup_curation=get(prediction, "pileup_curation", nothing)
    )
    
    return write(writer, cvo)
end

function add_pileup_curation_to_debug_info(debug_info::Dict, pileup_curation)
    if isnothing(pileup_curation)
        return debug_info
    end
    
    debug_info["pileup_curation"] = Dict(
        "diff_category" => pileup_curation.diff_category,
        "base_quality" => pileup_curation.base_quality,
        "mapping_quality" => pileup_curation.mapping_quality,
        "strand_bias" => pileup_curation.strand_bias,
        "read_support" => pileup_curation.read_support
    )
    
    return debug_info
end

function _create_cvo_proto(
    encoded_variant,
    gls::Vector{Float64},
    encoded_alt_allele_indices;
    true_labels=nothing,
    logits=nothing,
    prelogits=nothing,
    image_encoded=nothing,
    include_debug_info::Bool=false,
    debugging_true_label_mode::Bool=false,
    layer_outputs_encoded=nothing,
    pileup_curation=nothing
)
    variant = Dict()
    alt_allele_indices = Dict()
    
    debug_info = nothing
    if include_debug_info || debugging_true_label_mode
        if !isnothing(prelogits)
            @assert size(prelogits) == (1, 1, 2048)
            prelogits = prelogits[1, 1, :]
        end
        
        debug_info = Dict(
            "has_insertion" => false,
            "has_deletion" => false,
            "is_snp" => false,
            "predicted_label" => argmax(gls) - 1,
            "true_label" => true_labels,
            "logits" => logits,
            "prelogits" => prelogits,
            "image_encoded" => image_encoded,
            "layer_output_encoded" => layer_outputs_encoded
        )
        
        debug_info = add_pileup_curation_to_debug_info(debug_info, pileup_curation)
    end
    
    call_variants_output = Dict(
        "variant" => variant,
        "alt_allele_indices" => alt_allele_indices,
        "genotype_probabilities" => gls,
        "debug_info" => debug_info
    )
    
    return call_variants_output
end

function post_processing(
    output_file::String,
    output_queue,
    include_debug_info::Bool,
    debugging_true_label_mode::Bool
)
    writer = nothing
    n_examples = 0
    n_batches = 0
    
    while true
        try
            item = nothing
            if isnothing(item)
                break
            end
            
            (
                predictions,
                image_encodes,
                variants,
                alt_allele_indices_list,
                optional_label_list,
                layer_outputs,
                optional_pileup_curation_list
            ) = item
            
            for (i, probabilities) in enumerate(predictions)
                pred = Dict(
                    "probabilities" => probabilities,
                    "variant" => variants[i],
                    "image_encoded" => image_encodes[i],
                    "alt_allele_indices" => alt_allele_indices_list[i],
                    "layer_outputs_encoded" => Dict(
                        layer_name => output[i]
                        for (layer_name, output) in layer_outputs
                    )
                )
                
                if include_debug_info
                    if !isnothing(optional_pileup_curation_list)
                        pred["pileup_curation"] = optional_pileup_curation_list[i]
                    end
                end
                
                if debugging_true_label_mode && !isnothing(optional_label_list)
                    pred["label"] = optional_label_list[i][1]
                end
                
                write_variant_call(writer, pred, include_debug_info, debugging_true_label_mode)
                
                n_examples += 1
            end
            
            n_batches += 1
        catch error
            if isa(error, TimeoutError)
                @warn "Writer timeout occurred $error."
                break
            end
        end
    end
    
    @info "Wrote $n_examples examples over $n_batches batches. Closing writer."
end

function write_empty_output_file(examples_filename::String, output_file::String)
    @warn "Unable to read any records from $examples_filename. Output shards will contain zero records."
    
    total_writer_process = 1
    output_file = replace(output_file, ".tfrecord.gz" => "@$(total_writer_process).tfrecord.gz")
    
    paths = []
    for path in paths
    end
end

function load_model_and_check_shape(
    checkpoint_path::String,
    examples_filename::String,
    first_example,
    use_saved_model::Bool,
    use_examples_from_stream::Bool
)
    example_shape = []
    example_info_json = ""
    
    if !use_examples_from_stream
        example_info_json = ""
        
        example_shape = []
        
        if isnothing(example_shape)
            @info "Unable to read shape information from $example_info_json. Directly read from examples instead."
            
            example_shape = []
        end
    end
    
    if use_saved_model
        model = nothing
        model_example_info_json = "$(checkpoint_path)/example_info.json"
        model_example_shape = []
        channel_indices = []
        
        if !isempty(channel_indices)
            error("Channel ablation is not supported for saved model.")
        end
        
        if use_examples_from_stream
            example_shape = model_example_shape
        else
            if !isfile(example_info_json)
                filename_prefix = basename(example_info_json)
                filename_prefix = split(filename_prefix, ".")[1]
                sample_name = split(filename_prefix, "_")[end]
                expected_filename = replace(example_info_json, "_$(sample_name)" => "")
                
                if !isfile(expected_filename)
                    error("File $example_info_json or $expected_filename not found. Please check make_examples output.")
                end
            end
            
            if !use_examples_from_stream
                if model_example_shape[1] != example_shape[1]
                    @warn "Input shape $(example_shape[1]) and model shape $(model_example_shape[1]) does not match."
                end
                
                if model_example_shape[2] != example_shape[2]
                    @warn "Input channels $(example_shape[2]) and model channels $(model_example_shape[2]) do not match."
                end
            end
        end
    else
        model_example_info_json = nothing
        model_dir = dirname(checkpoint_path)
        
        for (root, dirs, files) in walkdir(model_dir)
            for file in files
                if endswith(file, "example_info.json")
                    model_example_info_json = joinpath(root, file)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        
        if !isnothing(model_example_info_json)
            example_shape = []
            channel_indices = []
        else
            error("Could not infer example shape from examples or model directory. example_info.json was not found in the model directory.")
        end
        
        if !isempty(channel_indices)
            model_example_shape = copy(example_shape)
            model_example_shape[3] = length(channel_indices)
            @info "Channel Ablation updates model input shape $model_example_shape."
        else
            model_example_shape = example_shape
        end
        
        @info "model_example_shape: $model_example_shape"
        
        model = nothing
    end
    
    return example_shape, model
end

function call_variants(
    examples_filename::String,
    checkpoint_path::String,
    output_file::String,
    writer_threads::Int,
    kmp_blocktime::String,
    batch_size::Int,
    include_debug_info::Bool,
    debugging_true_label_mode::Bool,
    activation_layers::Vector{String},
    use_dataset_from_stream::Bool,
    shm_prefix::String,
    num_shards::Int,
    allow_empty_examples::Bool
)
    first_example = nothing
    
    if !use_dataset_from_stream
        first_example = nothing
        
        if isnothing(first_example)
            write_empty_output_file(examples_filename, output_file)
            
            if allow_empty_examples
                @info "Allowing empty examples. Exiting."
                return
            else
                error("Examples file is empty. If you want to allow empty examples, please set --allow_empty_examples to True.")
            end
        end
    end
    
    is_gpu_available = false
    
    if writer_threads == 0
        total_writer_process = is_gpu_available ? Sys.CPU_THREADS : 1
    else
        total_writer_process = writer_threads
    end
    
    if false
        @info "Output is already sharded, so dynamic sharding is disabled."
        total_writer_process = 1
        paths = [output_file]
    else
        total_writer_process = min(total_writer_process, _MAX_WRITER_THREADS)
        
        output_file = replace(output_file, ".tfrecord.gz" => "@$(total_writer_process).tfrecord.gz")
        
        paths = []
    end
    
    writer_queues = []
    for _ in 1:total_writer_process
        push!(writer_queues, Channel())
    end
    
    writer_queues_iterator = Iterators.cycle(writer_queues)
    
    all_processes = []
    for process_id in 1:total_writer_process
        post_processing_process = @async post_processing(
            paths[process_id],
            writer_queues[process_id],
            include_debug_info,
            debugging_true_label_mode
        )
        
        push!(all_processes, post_processing_process)
    end
    
    @info "Total $(length(all_processes)) writing processes started."
    
    if !isempty(kmp_blocktime)
        ENV["KMP_BLOCKTIME"] = kmp_blocktime
        @info "Set KMP_BLOCKTIME to $(ENV["KMP_BLOCKTIME"])"
    end
    
    use_saved_model = isfile(checkpoint_path) && isfile("$(checkpoint_path)/saved_model.pb")
    
    @info "Use saved model: $use_saved_model"
    
    if isnothing(checkpoint_path)
        error("Checkpoint filename must be specified.")
    end
    
    channel_indices = []
    
    if !use_saved_model
        if !isdir(checkpoint_path)
            example_info_json_path = joinpath(dirname(checkpoint_path), "example_info.json")
        else
            example_info_json_path = joinpath(checkpoint_path, "example_info.json")
        end
        
        example_info = JSON.parse(read(example_info_json_path, String))
        
        for (idx, channel_enum) in enumerate(example_info["channels"])
            if !(channel_enum in get(example_info, "ablation_channels", []))
                push!(channel_indices, idx)
            end
        end
    end
    
    example_shape, model = load_model_and_check_shape(
        checkpoint_path,
        examples_filename,
        first_example,
        use_saved_model,
        use_dataset_from_stream
    )
    
    if isempty(example_shape)
        error("Could not infer example shape from examples or model directory.")
    end
    
    @info "example_shape: $example_shape"
    
    enc_image_variant_alt_allele_ds = get_dataset(
        examples_filename,
        example_shape,
        channel_indices,
        batch_size,
        include_debug_info,
        debugging_true_label_mode,
        use_dataset_from_stream,
        shm_prefix,
        num_shards
    )
    
    activation_model = model
    
    if include_debug_info && !isempty(activation_layers)
        if !use_saved_model
            activation_model = nothing
        end
    end
    
    batch_no = 0
    n_examples = 0
    n_batches = 0
    start_time = time()
    
    for (
        image_encodes,
        images_in_batch,
        variants,
        alt_allele_indices_list,
        optional_label_list
    ) in enc_image_variant_alt_allele_ds
        
        if use_saved_model
            predictions = nothing
        else
            if !is_gpu_available
                predictions = nothing
            else
                predictions = nothing
            end
        end
        
        layer_outputs = Dict()
        
        if include_debug_info && !isempty(activation_layers)
            if !use_saved_model
                if !is_gpu_available
                    layer_outputs = nothing
                else
                    layer_outputs = nothing
                end
                
                layer_outputs = Dict(
                    layer_name => output
                    for (layer_name, output) in layer_outputs
                )
            else
                @warn "Activation layers: $(join(activation_layers, ",")) are not saved in CVO. Change to ckpt model file to get activation layers outputs."
            end
        end
        
        pileup_curation_in_batch = nothing
        
        if include_debug_info
            pileup_curation_in_batch = []
        end
        
        batch_no += 1
        duration = time() - start_time
        n_examples += length(predictions)
        n_batches += 1
        
        if n_batches % _LOG_EVERY_N_BATCHES == 0
            @info "Predicted $n_examples examples in $n_batches batches [$(100 * duration / n_examples) sec per 100]."
        end
        
        if !isnothing(optional_label_list)
            optional_label_list = optional_label_list
        end
        
        next_queue = iterate(writer_queues_iterator)
    end
    
    for queue in writer_queues
        put!(queue, nothing)
    end
    
    for post_processing_process in all_processes
        wait(post_processing_process)
    end
end

function main(argv::Vector{String}=String[])
    env = copy(ENV)
    @info "call_variants: env = $env"
    
    if length(argv) > 1
        error("Command line parsing failure: call_variants does not accept positional arguments but some are present on the command line: \"$(argv)\".")
    end
    
    checkpoint = ""
    outfile = ""
    examples = ""
    batch_size = 1024
    max_batches = nothing
    num_readers = 8
    include_debug_info = false
    activation_layers = String[]
    debugging_true_label_mode = false
    execution_hardware = "auto"
    config_string = nothing
    kmp_blocktime = "0"
    writer_threads = 0
    limit = 0
    num_input_shards = nothing
    shm_prefix = "deepvariant"
    stream_examples = false
    allow_empty_examples = true
    
    if isempty(checkpoint)
        error("Checkpoint filename must be specified.")
    end
    
    if isempty(outfile)
        error("Output filename must be specified.")
    end
    
    if !endswith(outfile, ".tfrecord.gz")
        error("Output filename must end with .tfrecord.gz")
    end
    
    if !isempty(activation_layers)
        if !include_debug_info
            @warn "\"--include_debug_info\" need to be set True to have the input activation_layers: $(join(activation_layers, ",")) included in CVO."
        end
    end
    
    call_variants(
        examples_filename=examples,
        checkpoint_path=checkpoint,
        output_file=outfile,
        writer_threads=writer_threads,
        kmp_blocktime=kmp_blocktime,
        batch_size=batch_size,
        include_debug_info=include_debug_info,
        debugging_true_label_mode=debugging_true_label_mode,
        activation_layers=activation_layers,
        use_dataset_from_stream=stream_examples,
        shm_prefix=shm_prefix,
        num_shards=num_input_shards,
        allow_empty_examples=allow_empty_examples
    )
    
    @info "Complete: call_variants."
end

if abspath(PROGRAM_FILE) == @__FILE__
    main(ARGS)
end
